basic_profile.bio: Rezen is a passionate Valorant coach who has been active on Reddit for over six years. Based in the UK, he spends most of his time helping players improve their gaming skills. When not coaching, Rezen enjoys playing other games like Overwatch and exploring his hobbies such as playing the ukulele. He typically browses Reddit in the evenings, after his coaching sessions. Rezen is single and enjoys the flexibility of his freelance gaming career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Rezen has a deep understanding of the gaming world, particularly in Valorant, due to years of playing and coaching. He started as a self-taught player and gradually transitioned into coaching as he gained more expertise. His knowledge is further enriched by participating in online forums and gaming communities.
